boot.intro:
Run a team in MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, Rookies Cup, WorldSBK or WorldSSP. Sign riders, develop the bike, find sponsors and watch the books. Races are simulated and you can watch them live and give orders from the pit wall.

Start a new career to create your manager and pick a team.

rider.freeSeatInfo: Find a rider in the market to complete the line-up.
tut.home.1: Hi! I'm Lucía, your assistant. They've handed you the keys of the team: nice to meet you. Shall I show you around?
tut.home.2: At the top right you have the Continue button: it takes you to the next race, simulates an event or closes the season, whatever comes next.
tut.home.3: Under To do I'll leave whatever needs a decision: offers, contracts ending, free seats… Each item takes you to its screen.
tut.home.4: On the left are the sections: Team, Bike, Finances, Market and Competition. Each has its tabs at the top.
tut.home.5: Keep an eye on the money: the cash belongs to the organisation and the team has a season budget. Good luck!
tut.race.1: Race day! At the bottom you have a card for each of your riders: who's ahead and behind, the tyre, the fuel and the reliability.
tut.race.2: Use Pace to save or push, and Attitude to attack or defend. If you prefer, let the engineer decide.
tut.race.3: At the top you can change the speed, the camera (circuit, follow or sectors) and open the full Standings.
tut.race.4: Tap a rider in the standings to follow them. Zoom out and riders become circles showing their position. Go for it!
